# Example: Add to your repo's .github/workflows/qaverity.yml
#
# This workflow runs Qaverity on every PR and posts a comment summary.
# It also runs nightly for trend tracking.

name: Qaverity Audit

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
  schedule:
    # Run nightly at 2 AM UTC for trend tracking
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual triggers

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write  # Required for PR comments

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Qaverity Audit
        uses: your-org/repo-audit-agent@v3
        with:
          repo-path: "."
          output-dir: "./qaverity-out"
          format: "md,html,json,sarif"
          post-comment: "true"
          fail-on-high: "false"
          # Uncomment to push results to the Qaverity dashboard:
          # api-key: ${{ secrets.QAVERITY_API_KEY }}

      # Optional: Upload SARIF to GitHub Code Scanning
      - name: Upload SARIF
        if: always()
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with:
          sarif_file: ./qaverity-out/audit.sarif
          category: qaverity
